transcript.answer:
Otto was never built on Cloud Run. Otto deploys with Helm to the shared GKE Autopilot cluster `n8n-cluster` in `europe-west1`, and the Cloud Run plan was superseded. The reasons are in ADR-003 (decided 2026-10-19).

1. The region choice no longer made sense. #27 picked `europe-north1` to sit "in the same region as the Vertex model". Measured on 2026-10-16, `europe-north1` serves only the Gemini 2.5 family, which Google retires on 2026-10-20. The newer Gemini models answer only on the `eu` multi-region. ADR-003 says "the premise of the region choice is gone".

2. The planned Cloud Run build was never made. The terraform roots (`shared/`, `environments/poc/`, `bootstrap/`) and the `deploy-poc.yaml` workflow were never built, and neither was the planned `docs/adr/ADR-001-hosting-platform.md`. The repo has Helm charts, `infra/terraform` and a CI `deploy` job that deploys to GKE. Images go to ghcr.io.

3. ADR-003 also rejected the model's `global` endpoint. It runs every Gemini model but gives up the EU residency that the model allowlist exists to enforce.

Issues #27, #162 and #168 were closed as superseded.

judgements.reason: The answer states that on 2026-10-16 europe-north1 served only Gemini 2.5, which retires on 2026-10-20, that newer models answer only on the eu multi-region, and that Otto runs on GKE Autopilot n8n-cluster in europe-west1, matching the gold answer.
